Overview

Lovech is a city in Lovech with a population of 36,000. A picturesque city in central Bulgaria, known for its covered bridge designed by Kolyu Ficheto, the Lovech Fortress, and the nearby Devetashka Cave. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
